agent_review.author: agent

findings.summary: Fake Out flinch prevented the first Absorb, but the runner reported missing PP instead of classifying the action as flinch-prevented.
findings.improvement: Add flinch to prevented-action classification and regression-test the exact state/action.
findings.observed_fact: Croagunk Fake Out PP decreased; Grotle PP did not; Grotle remained alive.

findings.summary: The capture oracle selected crit-safe Absorb, while the generic certificate predicted Razor Leaf; prediction output must preserve the capture policy decision.
findings.improvement: Pass the capture-mode decision into the certified prediction instead of emitting an unrelated generic recommendation.
findings.observed_fact: Absorb was executed on the second attempt, dealt 9 damage, and left Croagunk at 18/27 without a KO.

findings.summary: Four non-target encounters were fled, no balls were wasted, and Croagunk was caught at 18/27 HP with balls 13 to 12.
findings.observed_fact: The target was weakened once after Fake Out and then caught safely.

correct_choices: Used ROM encounter data and bounded hunting.
Did not throw at full HP; used a crit-safe weakening move.
Stopped weakening when Absorb was no longer crit-safe and caught with L as Croakatoa.
agent_review.next_test: Add flinch classification and capture-policy prediction alignment, then run one isolated wild-capture regression.
